verdict.rationale: H200 publishes 141GB HBM3e at 4.8TB/s, explicitly cited as enabling large LLM inference with Llama2 70B benchmarks, and community evidence corroborates real-world 70B+ class inference (Llama 405B at 142 tok/s on H200 SXM) confirming practical single-node deployment. missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark specifically for quantized 70B inference throughput/latency rather than vendor-run comparisons.
